review.finding: Midnight fallback cancels A6 whenever a day boundary falls inside a release: resolve replaces the stored release_date with today when created_at is not today and the section is not rendered yet; preview and real run can disagree across 00:00 UTC.
review.suggestion: Apply the today-override only to a stale state (same _fresh/MAX_AGE_HOURS test prepare uses); set created_at=now when prepare re-dates a reused state; add an L1 test prepare 23:59 / aggregate 00:01.

review.finding: prepare writes the upgrade-note drop into the working tree before the model has answered gates.out_of_sequence or gates.version; declining or cancelling leaves a tracked drop behind (old flow ran the check at the start of Step 4).
review.suggestion: Return the classification from prepare without writing; write the drop at aggregate time or via a later step; add a test that an ask out-of-sequence prepare leaves the tree clean.

review.finding: Step 4 still restates the flag rules aggregate now owns (A4) and keeps the two raw aggregate_changelog.py command lines (logic-in-scripts-judgement-to-ai).
review.suggestion: Replace by one sentence naming aggregate as the owner; if frozen promises hash the wording, say so and retire in P4/P7.

review.finding: Idempotency glob '{run_id}_*.md' matches by prefix; underscore is ambiguous (page foo vs foo_v2).
review.suggestion: Exact match with fullmatch of '{id}_NNN.md'; test with foo.md and foo_v2.md.

review.finding: Sentence does not match status for skipped_release_written with action pages, and action_drop_exists is not reviewed by SKILL.md.
review.suggestion: Own sentence for skipped_release_written; treat action_drop_exists like action_drop_written.

review.finding: _pages drops non-ASCII paths printed C-quoted by git (core.quotePath), giving a false all-clear.
F14 boundary test is flaky at midnight (created_at kept while release_date rewritten).
review.suggestion: Fix created_at in the test or fix the first finding.

review.finding: state_path runs real git outside the injected runner; L1 tests depend on tmp_path not sitting inside a repo.
review.suggestion: GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES autouse fixture or route through the Runner.

review.finding: _json helper defined three times; SHIPWRIGHT_RUN_ID lookup read twice in resolve.
review.suggestion: One json_dict in release_runner.py; compute env_id once.

review.finding: Any non-zero setup exit without JSON is reported as setup_refused.
review.suggestion: Name it setup_failed or separate exit 2.

notes: Architecture rules block read; no profile file under project root so rule-id comparison could not run. No high findings. Areas checked without finding: argv injection (lists, no shell, --end-of-options), corrupt/missing state read as absent, per-worktree --git-path on Windows, atomic write.
